# authwise_guard_enrollment_key (Resource)

A Guard enrollment key: a secret that lets machines join one network as server nodes, with no person signing in and no node registered first. Hand `secret` to the machine (`awguard up --enrollment-key`, or a Secret the Guard operator reads in a Kubernetes cluster).

guard-control shows the secret once, so it is kept in state: **treat the state as sensitive.** A key is never changed: every argument replaces it, which revokes the old key and creates a new one with a new secret.

A key that is revoked or gone drops out of state at refresh, and the next apply creates a new one. So does a key that has expired or is used up, unless `recreate_if_invalid = false`. **Destroy revokes the key.** The nodes it enrolled stay; remove them separately if they should go too.

`node_group` adds every node the key enrolls to that group at join, so a machine that joins is reachable and served at once.

There is no import: the secret is never readable again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The key a cluster's connector replicas join with, renewed before it
# expires: the replacement is a new key with a new secret.
resource "time_rotating" "connector_key" {
  rotation_days = 25
}

resource "authwise_guard_enrollment_key" "connector" {
  tenant_id        = "t-01"
  network_id       = authwise_guard_network.office.guard_network_id
  description      = "gfk connector (${time_rotating.connector_key.id})"
  expiry_days      = 30
  max_uses         = 4
  node_name_prefix = "gfk-connector"
  node_group       = authwise_guard_node_group.gfk_connector.name
}

# The Secret the Guard operator's GuardConnection reads.
resource "kubernetes_secret_v1" "guard_enrollment_key" {
  metadata {
    name      = "guard-enrollment-key"
    namespace = "guard-system"
  }
  data = {
    key = authwise_guard_enrollment_key.connector.secret
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) The network's id, `authwise_guard_network.<name>.guard_network_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tenant_id` (String) The kit tenant's id (`t-…`) the Guard row belongs to. Guard has no tenant of its own since the tenant collapse (tf#65). The provider's `tenant_id` is not used. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the key is for, shown in the console.
- `ephemeral` (Boolean) Remove a node the key enrolled once it has been offline an hour: for autoscaled and short-lived machines. Refused on a one-use key (`max_uses` unset or 1).
- `expiry_days` (Number) Days from creation until the key stops working: 1 to 90. Unset is 30.
- `max_uses` (Number) How many machines may join with the key: 1 to 1000. Unset is 1. There is no unlimited key: 1000 is the ceiling and stands for it.
- `node_group` (String) A node group of the network, `authwise_guard_node_group.<name>.name`, that every node the key enrolls joins. While the key is unrevoked, the group cannot be deleted.
- `node_name_prefix` (String) Name a node `<prefix>-<host name>`, with a number added when the name is taken: a DNS label of at most 32 characters, not `nd`. Unset, a node is named after its host.
- `recreate_if_invalid` (Boolean) Drop an expired or used-up key from state at refresh, so that the next apply creates a new one. Default true. With false, such a key stays in state as it is (`state` says why), until it is replaced by hand. A revoked key is always dropped.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `expires_at` (String) When the key stops working, RFC 3339.
- `guard_enrollment_key_id` (String) The key's id, `ek-…`.
- `last_used_at` (String)
- `name` (String) The key's full name, `tenants/t-…/networks/n-…/enrollmentKeys/ek-…`. A node's `enrollment_key` names it.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The key, `gk_…`.
- `state` (String) `ACTIVE`, `EXPIRED` or `USED_UP`. A revoked key is not kept in state.
- `uses` (Number) How many machines have joined with the key.
